title: KnowMT-Bench: Benchmarking Knowledge-Intensive Long-Form Question Answering in Multi-Turn Dialogues
abstract: arXiv:2509.21856v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-Turn Long-Form Question Answering (MT-LFQA) is a key application paradigm of Large Language Models (LLMs) in knowledge-intensive domains. However, existing benchmarks are limited to single-turn dialogue, while multi-turn dialogue benchmarks typically assess other orthogonal capabilities rather than knowledge-intensive factuality. To bridge this critical gap, we introduce \textbf{KnowMT-Bench}, a new benchmark designed to systematically evaluate MT-LFQA for LLMs across knowledge-intensive fields, including medicine, finance, and law. To faithfully assess the model's real-world performance, KnowMT-Bench employs a dynamic evaluation setting where models generate their own multi-turn dialogue histories given logically progressive question sequences. translated_title: KnowMT-Bench：面向多轮对话中知识密集型长文本问答能力的基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2509.21856v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：多轮长文本问答（MT-LFQA）是大型语言模型（LLM）在知识密集型领域中的一个关键应用范式。然而，现有的基准测试仅限于单轮对话，而多轮对话基准通常评估的是其他正交能力，而非知识密集型的事实准确性。为了填补这一关键空白，我们提出了KnowMT-Bench，这是一个新的基准，旨在系统地评估大型语言模型在医学、金融和法律等知识密集型领域中的多轮长文本问答能力。为了忠实评估模型的真实表现，KnowMT-Bench采用了一种动态评估设置，即让模型在逻辑递进的问题序列下自行生成多轮对话历史。我们在多种大型语言模型上的实验表明，模型在多轮对话中的事实能力和信息传递效率均出现明显下降。我们进一步探究了潜在的……
tldr: 提出了KnowMT-Bench——首个用于动态评估大语言模型在医学、金融、法律等知识密集型领域多轮长文本问答能力的基准，实验揭示多轮对话会导致模型事实能力和信息传递效率显著下降。
en_tdlr: KnowMT-Bench is a new dynamic benchmark for systematically evaluating knowledge-intensive multi-turn long-form question answering of LLMs across medicine, finance, and law, revealing a clear degradation in both factual capability and information delivery efficiency in multi-turn dialogues.
